meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 装上后，要求安全审查时，Claude 会组建 3 名漏洞猎人和 2 名 PoC 工程师并行检查代码库，找出漏洞并尝试证明哪些能利用，最后输出带严重性评级和修复建议的报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“security-research”、“security review”、“vulnerability audit”等关键词，或要求进行安全审查、漏洞研究、发布前安全检查时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个仓库的安全性
say.note: 会启动并行安全团队检查全仓库。

say.text: 对当前分支的改动做漏洞审查
say.note: 针对 diff 范围查找漏洞并出报告。

say.text: 验证这个漏洞能不能被利用
say.note: PoC 工程师会尝试复现并给出结论。

howto.what_en: Claude assembles 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit the codebase in parallel, list findings, prove exploitability, and produce a severity-rated report with fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'security-research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', or when asked for security review, vulnerability research, pre-release security check, etc.
